reply_text:
*One ship-blocking finding* in `billing-anniversary` against `main`:

*CRITICAL — Renewal dates use the wrong month’s length* — `src/schedule.js:6–7`
The day is clamped against the source month, then used in the next month. JavaScript rolls invalid dates forward, skipping renewals:
• Jan 31, 2026 → *Mar 3*, instead of Feb 28.
• Jan 31, 2028 → *Mar 2*, instead of Feb 29.
• Feb 28 with anchor 31 → *Mar 28*, instead of Mar 31.

*Recommended fix:* Clamp against the *target* month’s length (`daysInMonth(year, month + 1)`). Add regression tests for short-month transitions, leap February, and successive renewals with a fixed anchor.

All 5 existing tests pass, but `test/schedule.test.js` covers only mid-month and December→January transitions, which miss this bug. No other findings. No files changed.
